# Hook Exports

This folder tracks agent hook definitions that were previously only stored in local VS Code chat state.

## Exported Hooks

- `task-complete-final-answer.md`

## Source

The `task-complete-final-answer.md` content was recovered from local chat session storage on 2026-04-02:

- `%APPDATA%/Code/User/workspaceStorage/<workspace-id>/chatSessions/*.jsonl`

Use this folder as the canonical, repo-tracked source so hook behavior is reproducible across machines and sessions.
